record.question: Words which are inscribed on the grave or the tomb in memory of the buried.
record.explanation: Answer A: Epitaph. An epitaph is commemorative wording about a dead person, especially on a gravestone. 'Inscription' can be any writing on stone, but the stem's grave and memorial purpose make epitaph the more specific match. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/epitaph Independently reviewed worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
